select 'SYCXT' as systemCode, h.vc_hetgs AS orgId, h.vc_hethm as contractCode, max(t.dec_qic) as periods, max(t.dt_riq) as planDate, sum(t.dec_shijzj) as rentAmount, sum(t.dec_benj) as principalAmount, sum(t.dec_lix) as interestAmount from sy_pm_zujjhb t left join sy_pm_hetb h on h.vc_hetbid = t.vc_hetbid left join sy_cm_hetgrgfb ch on ch.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and ch.vc_zhongl = '0' left join sY_OP_YuQXXB yq on yq.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and yq.vc_shifwj = '0' left join sy_pm_rongzxxb rz on rz.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid where t.dec_qic is not null and t.dec_qic <> 0 and h.vc_hetztm in ('1','10','13','2','4','5','6','7')
and a.contract_id in
#{item}
group by h.vc_hetgs, h.vc_hethm, to_char(t.dt_riq, 'yyyy-MM') order by h.vc_hethm, max(t.dt_riq)

select 'SYCXT' as systemCode, h.vc_hetgs AS orgId, h.vc_hethm as contractCode, t.dec_qic as periods, t.dt_riq as planDate, t.dec_shijzj as rentAmount, t.dec_benj as principalAmount, t.dec_lix as interestAmount from sy_pm_zujjhb t left join sy_pm_hetb h on h.vc_hetbid = t.vc_hetbid left join sy_cm_hetgrgfb ch on ch.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and ch.vc_zhongl = '0' left join sY_OP_YuQXXB yq on yq.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and yq.vc_shifwj = '0' left join sy_pm_rongzxxb rz on rz.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid where t.dec_qic is not null and t.dec_qic <> 0 and h.vc_hetztm in ('1','10','13','2','4','5','6','7')
and a.contract_id in
#{item}
order by h.vc_hethm, t.dec_qic

SELECT CONTRACT_ID FROM ( SELECT CONTRACT_ID , rownum rn FROM ( SELECT CONTRACT_ID FROM rpt_firr_new GROUP BY contract_id HAVING TRUNC(max(PLAN_DATE)) >= TRUNC(TO_DATE('2023-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY CONTRACT_ID ) WHERE rownum <= #{params.end} ) WHERE rn > #{params.start}

SELECT b.vc_hetgs AS orgId, 'SYCXT' as systemCode, -- 业务系统编号 a.contract_id as contractCode, --合同编号 max(a.plan_list) as periods, -- 期项 max(a.plan_date) as planDate, -- 承付日期 sum(a.rent) as rentAmount, --租金 sum(a.net_flow) as cashFlow, --净流量 sum(a.naf_cut) as principalAmount, --本金 sum(a.interest) as interestAmount --租息 -- 签约主体 -- IRR Rate -- a.inter_day nu_interday, -- 当期承付日期与上期承付日期相差的天数 -- a.interest_day dec_rilx, --日利息 -- a.interest_date dt_dangqzhyt, -- 当期最后一天 -- a.up_day nu_upday, --当期承付日期距上月最后一天的天数 -- a.down_day nu_downday, --当期承付日期距当月最后一天的天数 -- a.interest_cal dec_hanslx, -- 含税利息 -- a.interest_cal_aftertax dec_buhslx, --不含税利息 -- SYSDATE dt_chuangjsj -- 创建时间 FROM rpt_firr_new a
LEFT JOIN sy_pm_hetb b ON a.CONTRACT_ID = b.vc_hethm WHERE b.vc_hetgs IS NOT null
and a.contract_id in
#{item}
group by a.contract_id, to_char(a.plan_date, 'yyyy-MM'), b.vc_hetgs ORDER BY a.contract_id, max(a.plan_date)

SELECT b.vc_hetgs AS orgId, 'SYCXT' as systemCode, -- 业务系统编号 a.contract_id as contractCode, --合同编号 a.plan_list as periods, -- 期项 a.plan_date as planDate, -- 承付日期 a.rent as rentAmount, --租金 a.net_flow as cashFlow, --净流量 a.naf_cut as principalAmount, --本金 a.interest as interestAmount --租息 -- 签约主体 -- IRR Rate -- a.inter_day nu_interday, -- 当期承付日期与上期承付日期相差的天数 -- a.interest_day dec_rilx, --日利息 -- a.interest_date dt_dangqzhyt, -- 当期最后一天 -- a.up_day nu_upday, --当期承付日期距上月最后一天的天数 -- a.down_day nu_downday, --当期承付日期距当月最后一天的天数 -- a.interest_cal dec_hanslx, -- 含税利息 -- a.interest_cal_aftertax dec_buhslx, --不含税利息 -- SYSDATE dt_chuangjsj -- 创建时间 FROM rpt_firr_new a
LEFT JOIN sy_pm_hetb b ON a.CONTRACT_ID = b.vc_hethm WHERE b.vc_hetgs IS NOT null
and a.contract_id in
#{item}
ORDER BY a.contract_id, a.plan_list

select 'SYCXT' as systemCode, h.vc_hethm AS contractCode, t.Dec_qic AS periods, t.DT_RiQ AS planDate, f.dec_yisfje AS actualRepaymentRentAmount, f.dec_yisje AS actualRepaymentPrincipalAmount, f.dec_yislx AS actualRepaymentInteresAmount
from SY_PM_ZUJJHB@HYDB104 t left join SY_FM_ShouFKB@HYDB104 f on t.vc_hetbid = f.vc_hetbid and t.dec_qic = f.dec_qis and f.vc_xianjlxm = '100009' inner join sy_pm_hetb@HYDB104 h on h.vc_hetbid = f.vc_hetbid where 1=1
and h.vc_hethm in
#{item}
order by to_Number(Dec_qic)
